subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: seat counts, billing, security evidence
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@finhaven.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@finhaven.com, Laura Chen <laura@finhaven.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: we're ready to start

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier — excited to get moving. Per the conversation, we'd like Redwood to send the intake sheet and your baseline MSA + order form so our procurement and legal teams can align.

Quick facts to start (so you can assign the right intake route):
- Company: FinHaven Analytics (procurement@finhaven.com)
- First deployment: US cloud region only
- Initial seat count estimate: 18 seats (could ramp to 50 in Q4)
- Expected go-live: mid-July (tight)
- PO required: yes — procurement will need an invoice / PO flow
- Security: we need a SOC2 report and any data residency commitments

I'm attaching our internal MSA redline and procurement form (attachment stubs below) so you can see where they start. Please let us know your expected turnaround for an internal-facing counterproposal and whether you need a copy of our security questionnaire.

Attachments: (attachment: FinHaven_MSA_Draft_v1.pdf) (attachment: FinHaven_Procurement_Form.pdf)

Thanks — Emma

Emma Lopez
Head of Partnerships, FinHaven Analytics
emma@finhaven.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@finhaven.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff: seat counts, billing, security evidence

Emma — thanks, this is perfect. Welcome — excited to work with FinHaven. I've queued the intake and here's what we need to move to a first internal counterparty review: 

Action items for FinHaven (please reply-all):
- Confirm firm initial seat count (you listed 18) and any minimums for billing cadence (monthly/annual).
- Confirm billing contact and PO instructions (billing contact name, email, billing address, PO number required? format).
- Confirm whether procurement needs a vendor W-9 or international equivalent.
- Share your security questionnaire (if you want us to fill it) or confirm you'll accept our SOC2 report.
- Let us know if you require data residency guarantees beyond US-only.

Attached to help speed things up: Redwood MSA (baseline, .docx), Order Form template (Excel), and our intake checklist. I'm attaching the SOC2 report we use for procurement review as well.

Proposed timeline from Redwood Legal / Contracts: initial redline counterproposal within 3 business days of receiving the completed procurement/billing info and security questionnaire; negotiated redlines and order form exchange typically 1–2 rounds thereafter. If you need a faster SLA we can escalate to an accelerated lane (may require Sales/RevOps approval).

I've looped in Jordan and Marissa to own the commercial terms and redline coordination. Jordan — could you confirm whether we should propose seat-based pricing on the initial order (and whether a trial credit should be attached)? Marissa — can you take lead on the redline review once FinHaven sends back the completed procurement form?

Attachments: (attachment: Redwood_MSA_Baseline.docx) (attachment: OrderForm_Template.xlsx) (attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf) (attachment: Intake_Checklist.pdf)

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Contracting, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Kimberly / team — quick internal note: assigning redline ownership and follow-ups.

- Marissa: please own the redline review and first pass counterproposal. Target: 3 business days from when Emma confirms billing + security items.
- Rishi: please prepare a short SLA exception memo and fallback routing for dedicated capacity / regional residency if FinHaven asks for non-US options; we may need to price that separately.
- Kimberly: I'll own commercial concessions (trial credits and initial seat discount) and will align with Sales ops on PO invoicing cadence.

Marissa — I tagged a few unusual clauses in the draft Emma attached (limitation-of-liability language and a long audit covenant) — recommend we keep those in the intake log and flag the ones that need Legal's attention.

I'll update the shared intake tracker with FH-2027-028 and link the props.

— Jordan

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff: seat counts, billing, security evidence

Kimberly / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the templates. We've attached our procurement form (filled) and a short note on billing below.

- Confirmed initial seats: 18 active seats to start; will scale to 30 by Oct if all goes well.
- Billing: procurement needs a monthly invoice plus an invoice PDF for PO matching. Billing contact: Laura Chen (laura@finhaven.com). PO number will be added to the invoice (they require vendor address and tax ID).
- Procurement attached: (attachment: FinHaven_Procurement_Form.pdf) — includes billing address and PO instructions.
- Security: we have our SOC2 on file but would prefer Redwood to provide your SOC2 report. If you can also confirm encryption-at-rest and in-transit specifics that would help our security team.
- Data residency: US-only is fine for us.
- Pricing question: would you recommend seat-based pricing for 18 seats or a committed-usage model? We'd like a quick rec so procurement can finish paperwork.

I've pasted the relevant part of Kimberly's email below for clarity. Let us know if you want a quick 15-min sync after you review the procurement form.

Attachments: (attachment: FinHaven_Procurement_Form.pdf)
